title: Pricing & Clean Money
sub: Where doctrine and sales collide. Principles before price — get the structure right and the number is easy.

title: The clean-money test
displayText: One question decides if a revenue idea is safe.
say: Does the money depend on a worker's outcome, or is it a fee for sending a case? If yes to either — we don't do it.
note: Clean = a flat fee for using software, regardless of who wins or how many sign.

title: Four lines you never cross
note: Never: a % of winnings · a per-referral or per-case fee · splitting fees with attorneys · a success fee tied to settlements.

title: A flat subscription
displayText: Fixed. Decoupled from outcomes and client count.
say: The firm pays a fixed amount to use the software — it doesn't change based on who connects or whether any case wins.
note: A roster / membership fee. The only structure we quote.

title: Price on avoided cost
displayText: Anchor to the problem, not the Clio invoice.
say: Price against the staff hours we remove and the intakes that no longer get dropped — not against what other software costs.
note: Anchoring to other tools teaches them to see us as a cheaper tool.

title: The current tiers
displayText: Practice · Firm · Surge — CURRENT, not locked.
say: Let me confirm our live pricing and send it over — we've been refining the tiers.
note: Repricing under review with counsel. Do NOT present as final on a call. Confirm live numbers before quoting.

title: Scale by seats, not clients
displayText: Meter the software use — never the outcomes.
never: Volume pricing based on how many cases we send you.
say: If you want a volume conversation, we meter tool usage and seats — never clients delivered or cases won.

title: How to talk price
displayText: Lead with avoided cost, not a number.
say: You told me your coordinator spends six hours per intake — against that, the flat fee is small. What do you spend today getting a file ready to screen?

title: The money lines you never say
displayText: If they propose contingency or per-case — decline, route to counsel.
never: We only get paid when you win. / It's a small cut of the settlement. / Pay us per case we send.
say: It's a flat subscription for the software, and the worker's record is free and theirs.

title: Clean money is impossible to regret
sub: A flat fee for software, never a stake in a case. Anchor to avoided cost, scale by seats, confirm live numbers before you quote.
